title: wedelia helianthoides
intro: Wedelia helianthoides, commonly known as Wild Daisy or Siffra, is a flowering plant native to tropical regions of the Americas. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Wedelia helianthoides include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and show potential in treating various diseases such as diabetes and cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
